question: 单项选择：I _____ my homework. A. finish  B. finished  C. have finished  D. will finish
answer: 答案：C. have finished。解析：现在完成时：have + 过去分词。

question: 单项选择：She _____ to Beijing twice. A. has been  B. have been  C. went  D. goes
answer: 答案：A. has been。解析：主语she用has。have been to"去过"。twice"两次"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：We ______ (live) in this city for ten years.
answer: 答案：have lived。解析：for ten years"十年"，是现在完成时标志。完整：We have lived in this city for ten years.

question: 单项选择：I _____ this book three times. A. read  B. reads  C. have read  D. will read
answer: 答案：C. have read。解析：three times是现在完成时标志。

question: 翻译句子：我已经看过这部电影了。
answer: 答案：I have already seen this movie. 解析：have + 过去分词seen。already"已经"。

question: 单项选择：He _____ in this school since 2020. A. study  B. studies  C. has studied  D. will study
answer: 答案：C. has studied。解析：since 2020是现在完成时标志。主语he用has。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (be) a teacher for 20 years.
answer: 答案：has been。解析：for 20 years是现在完成时标志。完整：She has been a teacher for 20 years.

question: 单项选择：They _____ in China since last year. A. live  B. lived  C. have lived  D. are living
answer: 答案：C. have lived。解析：since last year是现在完成时标志。

question: 翻译句子：我从来没见过这么美的风景。
answer: 答案：I have never seen such beautiful scenery. 解析：never"从未"是现在完成时标志。seen是see的过去分词。

question: 单项选择：I _____ my keys. I can't find them. A. lose  B. lost  C. have lost  D. will lose
answer: 答案：C. have lost。解析：现在完成时，I can't find是结果。lose的过去分词是lost。
